text:
Liz: Quick kickoff 1: propose a 3-week PLG sprint bundling 40 starter credits + 3 ready-to-run prompt templates + a 20-min "quickstart lab" webinar. Hypothesis: combo will lift 7-day active rate by ~25% for new signups. Thoughts?
Hector: Nice. We should pick a crisp primary metric. Suggest: percent of new signups who achieve a successful generation within 24h AND time-to-first-success (TTFS) <= 5m. Secondary: gen_count_7d, retention_d30.
Priya: Cohorts = control | credits_only | webinar_only | combo. Baseline activation ~10%. Target ~12.5% (25% rel). Rough power n ~2k per arm for 80% power. If traffic low, run sequentially over 6 weeks.
Ben: Traffic sources: blog post, product banner, Discord, paid tweet. We'll append utm params like: ?utm_source=blog&utm_campaign=starter_bundle_v1&arm=combo. Also small paid push to dev communities day of webinar.
DevOpsBot: Promo pool created: bundle_launch_pool (3000 codes). API endpoint: POST /api/assign_promo {"user_id","pool":"bundle_launch_pool"} -> {"code","expires_at"}. Codes single-use.
Liz: Important: codes attach to account metadata promo_origin=bundle_launch and expiry 21 days. Make sure assignment idempotent on first-login.
Priya: Webinar: 12m demo (how to use 3 templates), 6m templates walk-through + quick edits, 2m CTA to claim credits + templates. Include a micro-benchmark slide with tokens/cost/latency per template.
Hector: Add a lightweight micro-eval: 5 gold prompts per template; measure acceptability across two model families. Goal: >=80% acceptability to avoid false promises.
Ben: Landing page microcopy tests: H1 variant A: "Try our starter bundle 1 instant credits + ready prompts" vs H1 B: "Reserve a quickstart lab + claim credits". CTA copy test: "Claim credits & try now" vs "Reserve seat + get credits".
Ben: Quick inline snippet for landing (curl):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-1","prompt":"Sales outreach: {{company}} - 1-paragraph intro"}'
```
Priya: Tracking schema: signup_source, promo_pool, promo_code, webinar_reg, first_success_ts, gen_count_24h, ttfs, retention_d7. QA: validate events end-to-end for a test account before launch.
Hector: For analysis label arms as arm_control | arm_credits | arm_webinar | arm_combo. Also capture assignment_timestamp and referral_utm.
Liz: Owners: Ben = landing + social narrative (draft Thursday), Priya = templates + webinar script (Thursday EOD), Hector = metric spec + analysis plan (Friday), DevOpsBot/Infra = promo integration + single-use enforcement (Friday). Weekly check-in Mon 10am PT.
Ben: I'll also draft two social narratives: one technical "how we shortened time-to-first-prompt" and one PM-focused "reducing friction in onboarding".
Priya: Small UX ask: include 1-click "try sample prompt" on landing (executes in console if logged in), otherwise pre-filled curl like above. Reduces TTFS friction.
DevOpsBot: Note: assignment endpoint requires service token; rotateable via /secrets. Next maintenance 1845600000-1845603600 UTC. Avoid deployment then.
Liz: Thanks all 1. I'll write the experiment brief and share a link in this thread when ready. :rocket:
